plugins.name: Calendar systems

versions.notes:
- The plugin page shows a sample rendered with the pattern the profile "registration date" row uses, so profile dates can be checked without opening a profile
- Registration, join and birthday dates in the profile follow the chosen calendar: they are formatted by the same app formatter the plugin rewrites
- Each hook now registers on its own, so one method missing from an app build no longer disables the rest; the page lists what could not be hooked

plugins.name: Call avatar

versions.notes:
- Replace the catalog icon with the supplied phone handset and signal arcs SVG.
- Translate settings and compatibility messages into Ukrainian, English and Russian using the application language, with English fallback.
- Extend mocked lifecycle regressions to all three languages and test language selection/fallback.

- Full-screen caller avatar for voice calls with a dark scrim and raised name/status text.
- Persistent display modes: always, before answer, or after connection is established.
- Semi-transparent dark backgrounds for inactive call buttons; selected and hangup buttons keep their native appearance.
- Restore the native UI for video calls, unavailable photos, disabled display windows, and plugin unload.
- Use public Android handler APIs and Java-thread drawing hooks; add mocked lifecycle regression tests.

plugins.author: entinyGram
plugins.description: Full-screen caller photo instead of the circular avatar in voice calls

plugins.name: Doc Viewer

versions.notes:
- Fix copied JVM byte buffers and bounded chunked reads without reflection.
- Repair XLSX sheet relationships, sparse cells and rich strings; EPUB manifests, chapter paths and XML entities; FB2 encodings and namespaces.
- Browse ZIP/JAR/AAR entries and open supported files in-app with bounded, private temporary extraction and cleanup.
- Fix archive totals and remove incorrect password detection. Unsupported TAR/compressed TAR files now use the stock viewer.
- Remove reflection from viewer controls and fix viewer resource cleanup.
- Repair DOCX namespaces, PPTX slide ordering, bounded ODF repeated cells, RTF escapes/codepages and MIME email decoding.
- Fix CSV quoted/multiline fields, Markdown links and recursion limits, Unicode chunk boundaries and JVM string decoding.
- Handle mirrored EXIF orientations and PDF failure cleanup; add parser and native-resource regression tests.

- Initial release of Doc Viewer for Inugram / entinyGram.
- Ported from the Python plugin by Daxo-Developer & @Daxo_OS.
- In-app viewing for PDF, images, text, code, JSON, CSV, Jupyter Notebooks, Markdown, HTML, SVG, office documents (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODF, RTF, EML), books (EPUB, FB2) and archives (ZIP, TAR).

plugins.author: Daxo-Developer && @Daxo_OS (original), entinyGram (Inugram port)
plugins.description: In-app viewer for PDF, DOCX, XLSX, text, code, images, archives and more

plugins.name: entinyGram SDK

versions.notes:
- The marketplace shows two sections: the official entinyGram catalog and the separate user repository (`user-plugins/index.json`) with community plugins
- The plugin page is redesigned into icon cards: description, author, source repository, plugin ID (tap to copy), requirements and the latest version, each as its own row with an icon
- User plugins are exported to the plugin release too (`pack-release.ts` now packs them as `<Name>-<version>.inu.js`), so in plain inugram they are offered as release downloads just like the official ones
- Installing in inugram downloads the file from the plugin release instead of opening a page

- Works in plain inugram: without the entinyGram bridge the SDK runs standalone and no longer crashes
- Marketplace reads the installed plugins from the app directory in standalone mode
- Installing from the marketplace in inugram hands over the download link and checksum
